title: Episode Journal
description: Audit and replay journal for runtime episodes. This is not durable memory.

episode_id.description: Stable identifier for this runtime episode.

runtime_manifest.description: Runtime, tool, environment, and schema version metadata needed for audit and replay.

steps.description: Execution and audit step records. This is not canonical state or durable memory.

commit_status.description: Episode or commit-group status after verifier and commit-controller handling.

rollback_status.description: Rollback or compensation status. Rollback is only available for reversible changes.

memory_write_effects.description: Audit references to memory-write effects. This is not the durable memory store and not learning.
